extensions.provenance: Tokens pinned by the user to app/(tabs)/styles/styles.tsx (React Native app); CSS custom properties in style/master.css keep the app's names. Inter 400/700 via Google Fonts <link>.

headline.purpose: Section heads, manifesto quote, document titles.

label.purpose: Chips, meta, fine print; sentence case.

shadows.name: bottom
shadows.purpose: Rest state of yellow button and icon tiles (--SHADOW_BOTTOM).

shadows.name: raised-hover
shadows.purpose: Store badges on hover, with 2px lift.

shadows.name: yellow-glow
shadows.purpose: Yellow button on hover, with 1px lift.

shadows.name: phone
shadows.purpose: Phone bezel: long drop, hairline edge, inner bevel.

motion.name: ease-out
motion.purpose: Shared easing for every transition and the screen wipe (--ease-out).

motion.name: screen-wipe
motion.value: clip-path inset(100% 0 0 0) to inset(0), scale 1.04 to 1, 0.8s ease-out; outgoing screen holds opacity 1 for 0.8s then hides
motion.purpose: Sticky phone screen swap per story step.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.value: prefers-reduced-motion: reduce disables all animation, transitions and smooth scroll

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Yellow app button; header download action.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; min-height: 44px; padding: 10px 20px; border-radius: 15px; font-family: Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; font-weight: 700; font-size: 15px; line-height: 1; text-decoration: none; background: var(--PRIMARY, #fbbf24); color: var(--DARK, #1a0f2b); box-shadow: 0 1px 5px #80808026; transition: transform 0.2s cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1), box-shadow 0.2s cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1), background 0.2s; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: var(--PRIMARY_LIGHT, #f5d76e); transform: translateY(-1px); box-shadow: 0 6px 16px -6px var(--PRIMARY_DARK, #c9a830); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--SECONDARY, #6d28d9); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Store Badge

components.css: .ds-store { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 12px; min-width: 190px; padding: 11px 20px 11px 16px; border-radius: 15px; background: var(--DARK, #1a0f2b); color: var(--LIGHT, #ffffff); text-decoration: none; font-family: Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; box-shadow: 0 18px 40px -18px #1a0f2b40, 0 2px 6px #1a0f2b14; transition: transform 0.25s cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1), box-shadow 0.25s cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1); } .ds-store:hover { transform: translateY(-2px); box-shadow: 0 22px 40px -16px #1a0f2b66, 0 2px 6px #1a0f2b1f; } .ds-store:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--SECONDARY, #6d28d9); outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-store span { display: flex; flex-direction: column; line-height: 1.15; } .ds-store small { font-size: 11px; opacity: 0.75; } .ds-store b { font-size: 18px; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: -0.01em; }

components.css: .ds-faq { border-top: 1px solid var(--LINE, #1a0f2b14); font-family: Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; color: var(--DARK, #1a0f2b); } .ds-faq details { border-bottom: 1px solid var(--LINE, #1a0f2b14); } .ds-faq summary { list-style: none; display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: center; gap: 16px; padding: 22px 0; font-weight: 700; font-size: 18px; letter-spacing: -0.01em; cursor: pointer; } .ds-faq summary::-webkit-details-marker { display: none; } .ds-faq summary::after { content: ""; flex: none; width: 12px; height: 12px; border-right: 2px solid var(--SECONDARY, #6d28d9); border-bottom: 2px solid var(--SECONDARY, #6d28d9); transform: rotate(45deg) translateY(-3px); transition: transform 0.3s cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1); } .ds-faq details[open] summary::after { transform: rotate(-135deg) translateY(-3px); } .ds-faq summary:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--SECONDARY, #6d28d9); outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-faq p { margin: 0 0 22px; }

components.css: .ds-story { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 40px; font-family: Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; color: var(--DARK, #1a0f2b); } .ds-steps { list-style: none; margin: 0; padding: 0; position: relative; } .ds-steps::before { content: ""; position: absolute; left: 11px; top: 8px; bottom: 8px; width: 2px; background: var(--SECONDARY_FLAT, #6d28d914); } .ds-steps li { position: relative; padding: 14px 0 14px 44px; font-weight: 700; font-size: 20px; letter-spacing: -0.02em; } .ds-steps li::before { content: ""; position: absolute; left: 4px; top: 50%; width: 16px; height: 16px; margin-top: -8px; border-radius: 50% 50% 50% 0; transform: rotate(-45deg); background: var(--LIGHT, #ffffff); border: 2px solid #6d28d966; transition: background 0.4s cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1), border-color 0.4s cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1), transform 0.4s cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1); } .ds-steps li.is-active::before, .ds-steps li:hover::before { background: var(--SECONDARY, #6d28d9); border-color: var(--SECONDARY, #6d28d9); transform: rotate(-45deg) scale(1.25); } .ds-phone { width: 160px; aspect-ratio: 945 / 2048; padding: 6px; border-radius: 28px; background: var(--DARK, #1a0f2b); box-shadow: 0 40px 80px -30px #1a0f2b73, 0 0 0 1px #1a0f2b, inset 0 0 0 2px #3a2d4f; } .ds-screen { width: 100%; height: 100%; border-radius: 22px; background: linear-gradient(var(--DARK_FLAT, #f2f2f2), var(--SECONDARY_FLAT, #6d28d914)); }

narrative.overview:
The site is the A BLOC mobile app laid flat on a white page. Every token is pinned to the React Native app's design system (`app/(tabs)/styles/styles.tsx`): the same white ground, the same deep violet-black ink, the same sun-yellow and royal-purple pair, the same 15px and 5px radii, the same Inter at two weights. Proof is never illustrated. It is real app screenshots inside a true phone frame, and on the landing page that phone stays put while the story scrolls past it.

Density is calm and editorial: large tight-tracked bold headlines, generous section breathing, muted violet-grey body copy capped at readable measures. Colour stays mostly in reserve on white, then arrives at full strength in two drenched bands, one purple and one yellow, so the page has two loud moments rather than constant noise. The site is light-only, like the app. The confirmed anti-reference is the generic app-launch template: a dark-gradient split hero with floating emoji badges.
keyCharacteristics: Light-only white ground, ink #1a0f2b, never pure black text.
Tokens mirror the app 1:1 (custom property names keep the app's `PRIMARY`, `SECONDARY_FLAT` casing).
Inter 400 and 700 only, loaded from Google Fonts.
Real screenshots in a dark phone bezel are the only imagery.
Soft, low, violet-tinted shadows. Nothing hard-edged.
Map-pin markers carry the outdoor-map language into the UI.

rules.name: The Mirror Rule
rules.body: A colour enters this site only if it exists in the app's `styles.tsx`. The site does not invent brand colours; Dusk Grey and Hairline are the only web-side additions, both derived from Night Violet.

rules.name: The Two Bands Rule
rules.body: Full-strength colour fills a whole section exactly twice on the landing page: Royal Purple for the manifesto, Sun Yellow for the close. Everything else rests on White or Mist.

rules.name: The Ink-On-Yellow Rule
rules.body: Anything set on Sun Yellow is Night Violet. Anything that must read as yellow on white uses Burnt Amber.

rules.name: The Two Weights Rule
rules.body: Inter 400 and 700 only. No 500, no 600, no italic (emphasis inside a headline is a colour change, not a style change).

rules.name: The Tighter-As-Bigger Rule
rules.body: Letter-spacing scales with size: -0.01em at 18px, -0.02em around 20px, -0.03em for titles, -0.035em for headlines, -0.04em for display.

rules.name: The Soft-Pool Rule
rules.body: Every shadow is blurred, negatively spread and tinted from Night Violet (or neutral grey at rest). Zero-blur offset shadows do not exist in this world.

dos: **Do** take every colour, radius and weight from the app's `styles.tsx`; check there before adding a token.
**Do** put Night Violet text on Sun Yellow, and use Burnt Amber when yellow-family text must sit on white.
**Do** show the product only through real app screenshots inside the phone frame.
**Do** make the store badge pair the primary action wherever download is the goal.
**Do** use Lilac Veil panels and fact chips for guidance and data, Yellow Wash chips for identity labels.
**Do** keep shadows soft, negatively spread and violet-tinted (see Shadow Vocabulary).
**Do** let headings stand alone: no kicker or eyebrow line above them.
**Do** honour `prefers-reduced-motion`: all transitions and the screen wipe switch off.
donts: **Don't** load or use Inter weights other than 400 and 700.
**Don't** add a dark theme or put a whole page on a dark ground; Night Violet is for ink, the phone bezel and the store badges.
**Don't** drench more than the two bands (purple manifesto, yellow close) on one page.
**Don't** set Sun Yellow text on white.
**Don't** use mock UI, illustrated phones or stock imagery in place of real screenshots.
**Don't** use emoji or icon-font glyphs as icons; icons are inline 24px line SVGs at 2px stroke.
